item.title: Centre Approves Rs 1,912.99 Crore Additional Disaster Aid For 5 States, J&K
item.description: New Delhi, Mar 13: The Centre has approved Rs 1,912.99 crore in additional financial assistance to five states and the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir affected by floods, flash floods, cloudbursts, landslides and cyclone ‘Montha’ in 2025, an official statement said on Friday. The decision was taken by a high-level committee (HLC) chaired by Union Home Minister Amit Shah, it said. item.title: JKAS Officer Sanam Mansoor Transferred
item.description: JAMMU, Mar 13: The Jammu and Kashmir Government has ordered the transfer of JKAS officer Sanam Mansoor, who was serving as Deputy Secretary to the Government in the Home Department. According to an order issued by the General Administration Department, Mansoor has been transferred in the interest of administration and directed to await further orders of adjustment in the department. See Order Copy Click Here….. The post JKAS Officer Sanam Mansoor Transferred appeared first on Daily Excelsior.

item.title: SC refuses to entertain PIL seeking menstrual leave policy across country
item.description: NEW DELHI, Mar 13: The Supreme Court on Friday refused to entertain a PIL seeking a nationwide policy providing menstrual leave for women students and workers, observing no one would give them jobs in such a scenario and that such a provision would unintentionally reinforce gender stereotypes. The top court, however, said the competent authority may consider the representation and examine the possibility of framing a policy on menstrual leave after consulting all relevant stakeholders. item.title: Curbs Imposed In Parts Of Kashmir; Protests Break Out In Shia Dominated Areas
item.description: SRINAGAR, Mar 13: Protests broke out on Friday in some Shia-dominated areas of Kashmir, including Magam and Budgam, against the US-Israel strikes on Iran, officials said. Apprehending the protests on the last Friday of Ramzan, restrictions were imposed this morning in Srinagar and other parts of the valley, especially the Shia-dominated areas. item.description: NEW DELHI, Mar 13: Lok Sabha proceedings were adjourned till 2 pm on Friday amid relentless protests by opposition members over the LPG situation and hike in its price due to the ongoing West Asia crisis. item.title: Opposition MPs Submit Notices In Both Houses Seeking Motion For Removal Of CEC Kumar
item.description: New Delhi, Mar 13: Opposition MPs have submitted notices in both Houses of Parliament seeking a motion for the removal of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar, sources said on Friday. As many as 130 Lok Sabha MPs and 63 Rajya Sabha MPs have signed the notice, a source said. item.title: CM Omar Abdullah Chairs Cabinet Meeting In Jammu; Key Decisions On Governance Taken
item.description: Jammu, Mar 13: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Friday chaired a Cabinet meeting here, paving the way for key decisions aimed at strengthening governance and accelerating development across the Union Territory.
